topic: Day 7 — carousel — A good life isn't the absence of hard things, it's having the hard things worth having

slides.text: It's just hard for a reason you'd choose again.
Struggle in service of something sustains you.
Same hardship, different meaning, completely different weight.

caption:
No life is free of difficulty. The only real question is whether the hard thing is one you'd choose again.

Follow for one of these a day.
